evidence.quote: the Committee has adopted a patient, wait-and-see approach to considering any alteration in the stance of policy.
The Committee is now well along in our discussions of a plan to conclude balance sheet runoff later this year.
Inflation will probably run a bit below our objective for a time due to declines in energy prices, but those effects are likely to prove transitory.
Right now, most measures of the health and strength of the labor market look as favorable as they have in many decades.
Despite this favorable picture, we have seen some cross-currents in recent months.
With nothing in the outlook demanding an immediate policy response and particularly given muted inflation pressures

parsed.rationale: The Chair signals patience on rates, muted inflation pressures, cross-currents, and an earlier end to balance sheet runoff, all leaning dovish despite a strong labor market. The discussion of makeup strategies to counter low inflation adds a mild dovish tilt.
